title: The power of Codex. Local, private, yours.
excerpt: A native OpenCode workspace for local and cloud models, voice, Computer Use, extensions, widgets, and secure Remote.

Questions, answered

Everything you need to know.

Is this an OpenAI or Codex product?

No. OpenCode Superapp is an independent, Codex-inspired product built on the open-source OpenCode runtime. It is not affiliated with or endorsed by OpenAI.

Do I need an OpenCode Superapp account?

No. The application has no profiles, passwords, or Supabase Auth. We use your purchase email only to deliver and recover your license.

Can I use local or self-hosted models?

Yes. Install the integrated Local AI extension for app-managed Ollama models, or configure any compatible provider supported by OpenCode. You can switch providers by task.

Which Macs are supported?

The initial release supports Apple-silicon Macs on macOS 13 or newer. Native Computer Use requires macOS 15 or newer.

How many devices can I activate?

Five desktop installations. Reinstalling on the same Keychain-backed installation does not consume another slot, and phone or browser companions consume none.

Do Superpowers work offline?

Browser Automation, Computer Use, and Dictation remain unlocked offline indefinitely. Realtime Voice uses its configured voice provider, and Remote requires a renewable 30-day entitlement grant.

How does the free Supe Voice trial work?

Eligible installations can opt into five total connected minutes across at most two sessions using a fixed xAI Voice configuration. Audio is transiently relayed through Cloudflare to xAI and is not stored by OpenCode Superapp. Tasks created by Voice still use your selected OpenCode coding model, provider, billing, and terms.

What if I lose my activation email?

Use the recovery page. We send a temporary magic link to the purchase email so you can free device slots or create a new one-time activation.

What is the refund policy?

Request a refund within 14 days of purchase. Refunds stop new activations and Remote renewal, but cannot revoke lifetime local tokens already issued to an offline device.

Your models. Your tools. Your Mac.

Build with fewer boundaries.

Start free. Supe will be there when you need a hand.

问题，已解答

您需要知道的一切。

Is this an OpenAI or Codex product?

不会。OpenCode Superapp 是一款独立的、受 Codex 启发的产品，构建于开源 OpenCode 运行时之上。 它不隶属于 OpenAI，也不受 OpenAI 认可。

Do I need an OpenCode Superapp account?

否。该应用程序没有配置文件、密码或 Supabase Auth。 我们仅使用您的购买电子邮件来交付和恢复您的许可证。

Can I use local or self-hosted models?

是的。 为应用程序管理的 Ollama 模型安装集成的本地 AI 扩展，或配置 OpenCode 支持的任何兼容提供程序。 您可以按任务切换提供商。

Which Macs are supported?

初始版本支持 macOS 13 或更高版本上的 Apple-silicon Mac。 本机计算机使用需要 macOS 15 或更高版本。

How many devices can I activate?

五个桌面安装。 在同一个钥匙串支持的安装上重新安装不会占用另一个插槽，手机或浏览器伴侣也不占用任何插槽。

Do Superpowers work offline?

浏览器自动化、计算机使用和听写功能将无限期地离线解锁。 实时语音使用其配置的语音提供商，而远程则需要可更新的 30 天授权。

How does the free Supe Voice trial work?

符合条件的安装可以选择使用固定 xAI 语音配置在最多两个会话中连接总共 5 分钟。 音频通过 Cloudflare 瞬时转发到 xAI，并且不由 OpenCode Superapp 存储。 Voice 创建的任务仍使用您选择的 OpenCode 编码模型、提供商、计费和条款。

What if I lose my activation email?

使用恢复页面。 我们会向购买电子邮件发送一个临时魔法链接，以便您可以释放设备插槽或创建新的一次性激活。

What is the refund policy?

购买后 14 天内申请退款。 退款会停止新的激活和远程续订，但无法撤销已颁发给离线设备的生命周期本地令牌。
